approach: Hybrid MARL-LNS (Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning + Large Neighborhood Search)
scientific_goal: Balance solution quality (via MARL collision reduction) and computational efficiency (via Prioritized Planning) to achieve higher success rates in complex environments

named_methods.MARL: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with shared policy for collision-aware neighborhood selection
named_methods.LNS: Large Neighborhood Search framework for iterative path repair
named_methods.EECBS: Explicit Estimation CBS as optimal baseline

key_mechanisms: MARL-guided neighborhood selection (choosing which agents to replan)
Early-stage MARL collision reduction (pre-processing before LNS)
Adaptive switching between MARL and PP based on collision count
comparison_structure: MARL-LNS vs Pure PP (benefit of MARL)
MARL-LNS vs MAPF-LNS2 (benefit of MARL-guided selection)
